about: Stuck cases collected from runs and tickets (#271 step 2). Each case is a sequence of CLI steps run in one room; a step that starts with '!' is expected to be refused. expect_kinds is what `klatch stuck` shows afterwards; expect_proposals is how many proposals the rules-only mediator posts. detectable false marks a case rules cannot see: it is recorded so the model-backed mediator (step 4 of #271) has the cases that the rules alone cannot settle.

cases.name: overwrite-after-deadlock
cases.note: after the deadlock the yielder lets go and the later editor takes the file and replaces the earlier result; nothing klatch can see is stuck any more, so no event and no proposal: whether the second edit should build on the first is semantic

cases.name: two-tasks-need-the-same-result
cases.note: two members ask for the same thing in different words, or two tasks both write one result; klatch compares paths and numbers, never wording, so it shows nothing until an ask goes stale
